Irrigation Technician
Employer:Rita's Farm Produce Pty Limited
Location: 1204 Mamre Road, Kemps Creek, NSW 2178, Australia
Employment type: Full-time, 38 hours per week
Remuneration: $75,000 - $85,000 

About Rita Farm
Since its establishment in 2001, Rita's Farm Produce Pty Limited has been deeply engaged in Australia's organic agriculture sector for over 20 years. It is a highly reputable certified organic family farm in New South Wales, located at 1204 Mamre Road, Kemps Creek, covering an area of 55 acres. Adhering to strict organic farming standards, the farm consistently upholds the core philosophy of "growing food as medicine" and is committed to providing high-quality organic fruits, vegetables, and baked goods—free of chemical pesticides and synthetic fertilizers—to Sydney, Canberra, and surrounding regions.
We adhere to sustainable agricultural practices and protect biodiversity through ecological balance technologies, having now become a benchmark brand in the local organic agriculture sector. To support the farm's large-scale development and the refined management of its irrigation systems, we are sincerely inviting professional irrigation technicians to join us in jointly safeguarding the core lifeline of organic farming.

Duties & Responsibilities
System Operation & Maintenance Management: Responsible for the daily operation, inspection, maintenance, and troubleshooting of drip/sprinkler irrigation systems (including water pumps, pipelines, etc.), ensuring the precise irrigation needs of 55 acres of organic crops are met.
Irrigation Plan Development: Develop scientific irrigation plans based on organic standards, crop cycles, soil, and climate data. Precisely control water volume and frequency to ensure certification compliance.
Fertigation Integration Operation: Operate relevant equipment to precisely mix organic fertilizers for simultaneous irrigation. Monitor the process and record data to ensure efficient nutrient absorption.
Data Optimization & Review: Establish operation records for irrigation systems, documenting equipment status, test data, etc. Regularly analyze efficiency and propose optimization or upgrade suggestions.
Safety & Collaboration Assurance: Adhere to WHS (Work Health and Safety) standards. Coordinate with the planting team and farm manager to provide irrigation technical support and participate in planting planning meetings.

Selection Criteria / Skills & Qualifications
Possess 1-3 years of relevant experience in irrigation system installation/maintenance, or practical experience in horticultural/agricultural irrigation.
Proficient in the operation and maintenance of core irrigation system components, including pumps, valves, piping, and irrigation controllers, with a solid understanding of water supply scheduling logic.
Have a basic grasp of the principles of hydraulic parameters in agricultural/horticultural settings and an understanding of water resource optimization and management methods.
Adaptable to outdoor working environments, capable of independently completing physical work tasks, and equipped with reliable maintenance execution capabilities.
Demonstrate strong communication and coordination skills, able to effectively collaborate with farm teams and management.
Meticulous and reliable in work, prioritize work safety, strictly comply with labour hire industry standards, and adhere to high-quality craftsmanship requirements.
Flexible to adjust work arrangements in line with the farm’s production cycles.

What We Offer
Competitive salary for a full-time, 38-hour week role.
Stable employment with compliant labour-hire arrangements, including rostered hours, structured workforce management, and professional work conditions aligned with our values of integrity, reliability, and compliance.

More information
For more information, please email(adding company email). To learn more about working with us, we encourage you to visit our website
https://www.ritasfarm.com.au/

Visa sponsorship

Job Title	 Reception Centre Manager
Salary range	 $79,500 - $90,000 + Superannuation – depending on skill level
Job Closure date	 30 days

About Our Client
Our client is an award-winning luxury hotel, renowned as a vibrant and sophisticated landmark that seamlessly blends contemporary design with unparalleled, personalized service. This dynamic precinct is a hub of luxury accommodation, exclusive retail, and world-class dining, celebrated for creating immersive and memorable experiences from the moment a guest arrives. The atmosphere is one of modern energy and refined comfort, setting a new standard for hospitality.

About the Role
We are recruiting on behalf of our client for a distinguished Reception Centre Manager to serve as the operational leader of the hotel’s reception and guest services teams. This pivotal role is the embodiment of the hotel’s brand at the frontline, responsible for the entire guest arrival and departure experience. You will be the strategic leader ensuring the seamless operation of the reception centre, from managing room allocations and concierge services to mentoring a team of professionals dedicated to creating flawless first and last impressions. This position requires a unique blend of strategic oversight, hands-on leadership, and a passion for delivering exceptional guest interactions.

Key Responsibilities & Duties

Guest Experience & Service Leadership
• Provide inspirational leadership and strategic direction to the front office team, including Reception, Concierge, and Guest Services, setting the benchmark for five-star service standards and personalized guest interactions.
• Oversee the entire guest journey through the reception centre, from pre-arrival planning and streamlined check-in/check-out processes to resolving any concerns with discretion, efficiency, and a genuine desire to exceed expectations.
• Act as a visible and approachable presence on the floor, personally welcoming VIP guests, overseeing complex arrivals and departures, and ensuring the lobby environment consistently reflects the hotel’s energy and sophistication.

Operational Excellence & Administration
• Manage all operational aspects of the reception centre, including room inventory management, billing and folio accuracy, and the efficient handling of all guest correspondence and administrative tasks.
• Develop, implement, and refine front office procedures and systems to maximize efficiency, enhance the guest experience, and ensure flawless communication between departments such as Housekeeping, Maintenance, and Sales.
• Take full responsibility for the security and confidentiality of guest information, safe deposit box procedures, and key card management, upholding the highest standards of safety and privacy.

Team Management & Development
• Lead the recruitment, training, and ongoing professional development of the front office team, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
• Manage team performance through regular reviews, constructive feedback, and the creation of structured development plans to nurture talent from within.
• Prepare and manage staff rosters to ensure optimal staffing levels that align with occupancy forecasts and business demands, while also controlling labour costs and maintaining service quality.

Financial & Strategic Contribution
• Analyze front office performance data, including guest satisfaction scores and financial reports, to identify trends, drive revenue opportunities, and contribute to the strategic planning of the department.
• Manage departmental budgets and control expenses related to front office operations, including supplies and team-related costs, without compromising the luxury guest experience.

Candidate Profile & Requirements
• Proven experience in a senior Front Office or Reception Management role within a luxury hotel environment.
• A natural leader with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, capable of inspiring a team and building genuine rapport with guests and colleagues.
• Impeccable organizational skills and a meticulous eye for detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic setting.
• Strong financial and business acumen, with experience in budgeting, rostering, and performance analysis.
• Comprehensive knowledge of hotel property management systems (e.g., Opera) and front office procedures.
• A professional and polished demeanour, with the flexibility to work across a rotating roster, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays.

To Apply
If you are a hospitality professional with the vision and expertise to lead the front line of a prestigious luxury hotel, we invite you to apply. Please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your leadership philosophy and suitability for this role.

Please note: All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality. We are acting as the exclusive recruitment partner for this role and our client's identity will be disclosed to shortlisted candidates.

Smart Hill Constructions Pty Ltd 
(Reso Scaffold)
16 Prospect Place, Boronia VIC 3155

Full Time Architectural Draftsperson
$95,000 + superannuation

Summary
Smart Hill Construction Pty Ltd, trading as Reso Scaffold, is a growing construction company specialising in residential, commercial and industrial building projects. As the business continues to expand its design-and-construct capability, the company requires an experienced Architectural Draftsperson to prepare detailed architectural documentation, support project planning and coordinate technical drawings throughout the construction process.

Our Architectural Draftsperson will be responsible for preparing architectural drawings and construction documentation, interpreting design concepts, coordinating technical information and supporting the delivery of residential and commercial construction projects. The position provides specialised drafting support across the business and contributes to efficient project delivery, design coordination and regulatory compliance.

Duties and Responsibilities

Design Documentation and Drafting
•	Prepare architectural drawings, plans, elevations, sections and detailed construction documentation using CAD, Revit and BIM software
•	Translate architectural concepts, sketches and design specifications into accurate technical drawings for construction purposes
•	Revise and update drawings to reflect design changes, engineering requirements and client variations throughout project deliver

Project Documentation and Coordination
•	Prepare documentation required for planning approvals, building permits and construction documentation packages
•	Coordinate architectural drawings with structural, civil, mechanical and other consultant documentation to minimise design conflicts
•	Maintain project drawing registers, revision histories and document control throughout each stage of construction

Technical Design Support
•	Interpret building codes, Australian Standards and planning requirements when preparing architectural documentation
•	Assist with material selections, construction detailing and specification preparation to support project outcomes
•	Produce 3D models, presentation drawings and visual representations where required to assist project coordination and client communication

Stakeholder Liaison
•	Liaise with Architects, engineers, project managers, consultants and clients to clarify design requirements and technical information
•	Coordinate drawing revisions and technical documentation arising from project meetings and consultant feedback
•	Support communication between design and construction teams to facilitate efficient project delivery

Quality Assurance and Compliance
•	Review drawings to ensure accuracy, completeness and compliance with project specifications and applicable regulations
•	Maintain drawing standards, templates and documentation procedures in accordance with company quality systems
•	Assist in resolving design documentation issues during construction and support continuous improvement of drafting processes

Assessment Criteria
•	A relevant qualification in Architectural Drafting, Building Design, Architectural Technology, Architectural Interior Design or a closely related discipline, or relevant industry experience
•	At least three years of relevant experience preparing architectural drawings and construction documentation for residential and/or commercial building projects
•	Demonstrated proficiency using computer-aided drafting software such as AutoCAD, Revit or other comparable CAD/BIM platforms
•	Experience preparing and revising floor plans, elevations, sections, construction details and other technical documentation
•	Ability to interpret architectural concepts, engineering drawings and technical specifications and translate them into accurate construction documentation
•	Ability to communicate and coordinate drawings with architects, engineers, consultants and construction personnel throughout project delivery
•	Understanding of construction methods, building materials and document control procedures
•	Experience managing drawing revisions, version control and project documentation
•	Strong attention to detail with the ability to produce accurate and high-quality technical drawings
•	Well-developed communication and organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines
•	Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with all levels of stakeholders


How to apply:

Applications open on 13 July 2026 and close on 12 August 2026 

Please send your CV to info@businessnest.com.au. Please include the job role title in your email.

Blu Pantera Tech Pty Ltd
Fortitude Valley, Brisbane QLD 4006
Full time
$140,000 – $180,000 per year + superannuation

About position
The SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) Consultant is responsible for analysing business requirements, and designing, configuring and implementing SAP EAM solutions that optimise asset management and maintenance processes for clients operating in asset-intensive industries. The role partners with business stakeholders to maximise asset reliability, reduce maintenance costs and support digital transformation through effective SAP EAM solutions, while ensuring project delivery meets quality standards, timelines and client requirements.

Responsibilities
- Consult with clients, users and stakeholders to understand organisational objectives, operational requirements and asset management needs.
- Identify, investigate and analyse business processes, procedures and work practices to determine inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement.
- Define, document and validate functional requirements for SAP solutions supporting asset management and maintenance operations, and recommend process improvements and system enhancements.
- Design, configure and implement SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) solutions aligned with operational requirements and industry best practice, including asset structures, functional locations, equipment records, maintenance notifications, work orders, preventive and corrective maintenance processes, maintenance plans and maintenance strategies.
- Develop functional specifications, data and process models, system documentation and process maps to support SAP solution design, configuration and development.
- Collaborate with technical consultants, developers and project teams to deliver integrated SAP solutions that meet business requirements and technical standards.
- Apply project management methodologies, principles and techniques to develop project plans, estimate costs, allocate resources and manage SAP EAM implementation activities to achieve project milestones and deadlines.
- Develop and execute test plans, including unit, integration and user acceptance testing (UAT), and coordinate data migration, master data validation, system deployment and go-live activities.
- Prepare user documentation, business process documentation and training materials, and deliver formal training to end users.
- Provide post-implementation support, troubleshoot functional issues and monitor SAP EAM processes and performance to identify improvements.
- Act as a central functional reference point throughout project delivery, liaising with clients, users, project managers, developers and cross-functional teams to ensure solutions meet requirements, quality standards and project objectives.

Skills and Qualifications required to perform the above job role
- Tertiary qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Systems or a related discipline. 
- SAP certification or relevant SAP EAM/PM training is highly regarded.
- Minimum of 5 years' experience implementing and supporting SAP Enterprise Asset Management (SAP EAM/PM) solutions.
- Strong business analysis skills, with the ability to identify business requirements, analyse processes and develop functional specifications, process models, documentation and test plans.
- Experience in project management, with strong analytical, problem-solving and organisational skills, and the ability to oversee the implementation of complex IT projects.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage with technical teams, business stakeholders and end users.

About our Organisation

AVK is a highly respected global business and one of the leading valve manufacturers in the water supply, wastewater, civil infrastructure, gas, fire protection and industrial sectors. The AVK Group operates more than 100 companies worldwide, supplying to more than 80 countries and employs around 5,300 people. AVK's core business is the design and manufacture of valves, hydrants, fitting, clamps, and accessories each complying with the highest standards of quality, safety, and durability. In addition to the products, AVK Smart Water systems provide digital solutions for AVK core products through intelligent IoT-based platform as a new way for asset owners to monitor water infrastructure. 
AVK Australia is part of the Global AVK Group and responsible for the group’s activities in the Oceania region (Australia, New Zealand, Papua New Guinea & Pacific Islands). AVK Australia is based in Wingfield, South Australia, with operations across Australia as well as New Zealand.

About the Role 

We are currently seeking a Governance & Commercial Legal Advisor to join our team on a permanent full-time basis. 

Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, the Governance & Commercial Legal Advisor will be responsible for supporting organisational governance, regulatory compliance, internal controls and business risk management across the organisation.

The position provides advice and support to management and project delivery teams through risk management initiatives, analysis of organisational information and data, and implementation of processes that ensure compliance with regulatory and governance requirements.

Key Responsibilities

•	Working with Project Delivery team develop and implement systems for document control, including approvals and version controls
•	Analysis of project costs and forecasts to identify potential for variations and forecast project profitability
•	Analysing project performance data to support organisational planning, decision-making and process optimisation
•	Reviewing contracts and templates to ensure regulatory compliance and analyse to identify potential risks
•	Develop, review and maintain organisational policies, procedures, templates and governance documentation
•	Analyse and assess government and industry programs, including grant programs, and identify opportunities for the company to participate
•	Develop a "Tender Toolbox" for use in Project Tender Submissions, containing relevant Governance and Compliance documentation
•	Administration of Regulatory Compliance Program
•	Support the implementation of risk management IT systems in HSE, Quality and HR operations
•	Assist business managers to design, develop and implement corrective action programs to address legal compliance risks and / or adapt to changes in the regulatory environment
•	Analyse duty costs, identify opportunities for duty drawback claims, and administer regular claims
•	Maintain governance registers and organisational records relating to corporate assets and compliance obligations

Skills & Experience

•	A relevant Bachelor Degree or higher and a minimum of 12 months relevant experience. 5 years’ experience may be considered in lieu of qualification
•	Experience reviewing contracts, policies and governance documents 
•	Ability to analyse data and other information to support forecasting and decision-making
•	Ability to engage with stakeholders to coordinate effective organisational outcomes
•	Highly organised, with strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities
•	Strong verbal and written communication skills

If this sounds like the job for you, then please apply now by submitting your CV and a covering letter, in Word format, addressing the selection criteria.  

Visit our website http://www.avkcivil.com.au to learn more about the company, or our global website www.avkvalves.com to learn more about the AVK Group in general.

Operating since 1982, Werner Engineering has an unparalleled reputation as the one stop engineering workshop of choice. They use the latest technology to offer fast, accurate and high quality workmanship to minimise down time and increase productivity and efficiency for their clients.

Werner Engineering is locally owned Mackay-based machining and fabrication workshop, specialising the manufacture and repair of parts for the mining, transport, sugar, agricultural and local industries

Werner Engineering is looking for FITTER/MACHINIST to join their team of professionals on a full time and permanent basis.

To be considered for the role you will possess the following skills, experience, and attributes:
Trade qualified Fitter/Machinist
Forklift High Risk Ticket / Overhead crane / Dogging certificate highly regarded
Proven work experience in Fitting/Machining or similar role in the last 2 years
Previous experience in a workshop environment and understanding of Mining / Agricultural equipment and processes
Good technical background and ability to handle “one off’s” with attention to detail
Demonstrated experience in manual machining
A good working knowledge of drills, lathes and mills

Typical duties may include, but are not limited to: Fitter/Machinist

General machining including use of: Small Centre Lathes, Milling Machines, Radial Drills.
Keep abreast of technological changes

Application of fine tolerances to machined surfaces when fitting bearings, gearing, seals etc. to shafts and hubs with respect to heating/freezing techniques and the like
Sketch and accurately measure mechanical components from Gearboxes, Pumps and other Drive Equipment
Inspect, analyze and record critical mechanical information during the process of undertaking mechanical refurbishment work; this critical information would include the interpretations of wear and tear, mechanical damage to Gears, Shafts, Housing etc. recording of end floats, preloads, gear train, backlashes, tooth contacts and other at the start and completion of every refurbishment

Understand specifications of the task at hand and the desired result by reading mechanical drawings

Self-motivation and positive attitude.
Attention to detail and delivery of services to exceed client’s expectations.
Ability to Work Alone and In a Team environment
High level reasoning ability and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication skills and interpersonal skills
Flexible, adaptable, and resilient to stress.
Excellent math’s skills

This role suits an experienced professional with a solid background in telecommunications network planning, optimisation, and operational support who is looking to make a meaningful contribution within a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

- Conduct detailed network capacity planning and demand forecasting to anticipate future infrastructure requirements and prevent service degradation
- Analyse network data and performance metrics to identify areas for improvement and implement targeted optimisation strategies
- Prepare and maintain accurate technical documentation, including network plans, design specifications, and project reports
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams including engineering, operations, and project management to deliver network projects on time and within budget

- Proven ability to analyse complex technical data, identify root causes, and develop practical solutions

Sopho Pty Ltd as trustee for the Sopho Unit Trust trading as Kangaroo Valley Golf & Country Retreat, operates a distinctive accommodation and hospitality destination in the heart of Kangaroo Valley, NSW, within the Southern Highlands and South Coast region and an easy two-hour drive from both Sydney and Canberra. The Retreat is centred on a historic 1901 Woolshed — relocated from Uri Park in outback NSW and lovingly restored in 1983 — which today houses The Woolshed Restaurant and provides a characterful setting for guests and private functions alike. The property is complemented by an 18-hole championship golf course designed by Jack Newton, and by Osteria La Vallata, an Italian-inspired fine-dining restaurant led by Chef Marco Salvestrin.

Welcoming overnight guests, golf and leisure visitors, function and event parties, and regional tourists, Kangaroo Valley Golf & Country Retreat delivers a premium accommodation and hospitality experience across its accommodation, dining, and recreation offerings. As a destination property in a popular regional tourism location, the Retreat depends on attentive, individualised guest care and consistent day-to-day operational oversight to maintain its standing and the high standard of guest experience for which it is known.

As part of its continued growth, Sopho Pty Ltd is seeking to appoint a skilled and experienced Accommodation and Hospitality Manager in a permanent full-time position. The role is responsible for the overall administration and day-to-day operation of Kangaroo Valley Golf & Country Retreat, with a primary focus on accommodation services and the personalised guest experience across the property. The role offers a salary range of AUD $75,000 to AUD $85,000 per annum plus superannuation, commensurate with the successful candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.

Job tasks and responsibilities
1.  Direct and oversee major accommodation - related operations such as reservations, reception, room service, and housekeeping activities across the property's 30 self-contained one-, two-, and three-bedroom cabins and villas, ensuring that turnaround, presentation, and guest check-in/check-out standards are consistently met.
2.  Plan and coordinate special functions, conferences and private events held in the Conference & Events Centre, liaising with clients on room setup, AV/presentation equipment and catering requirements.
3.  Coordinate closely with the Executive Chef to align front-of-house service delivery with kitchen output, executing and leading front-of-house service across Osteria La Vallata restaurant, in-room dining and event catering to deliver a seamless overall guest hospitality experience.
4.  Direct the Greenkeeper Superintendent and golf course maintenance team to ensure the 18-hole championship course and surrounding grounds are presented and maintained to the standard expected of guests and members.
5.  Supervise security arrangements and, through the Maintenance Manager, the upkeep of buildings, gardens, pools, tennis courts and other recreational facilities used by guests.
6.  Oversee the selection, training, rostering and supervision of accommodation, guest services, maintenance, golf course and other staff, and ensure compliance with occupational health and safety regulations across the site.
7.  Observe liquor licensing, food safety, health and other regulatory requirements relevant to the accommodation, restaurant, golf and function operations.
8.  Assess and review guest and customer satisfaction through feedback channels and online review platforms, and implement service improvements accordingly.
9.  Oversee purchasing and accounting activities related to accommodation, hospitality and course-maintenance operations, including supplier arrangements for housekeeping, maintenance, kitchen and guest amenities.
10.  Provide guests with local tourism information and coordinate golf, dining and activity bookings as part of the retreat experience, arranging tours or transport where required.
11.  Handle guest complaints and service escalations, negotiating with suppliers and other stakeholders to resolve issues, and conduct ongoing quality checks across accommodation, dining and event operations, initiating corrective action where standards are not met.
12.  Lead public relations and marketing initiatives to promote the Retreat and grow accommodation patronage
13.  Report on operational performance, staffing and guest service outcomes to the Operations Manager and General Manager, and contribute to forward operational planning, performance forecasting and risk management to support the retreat's ongoing service standards and growth.

How to join the team
To join our dedicated team for a rewarding career, please submit an online application. Only successful applicants will be contacted. Candidates must hold Australian or NZ Citizenship or have the capacity to permanently work in Australia. Employment of a temporary visa holder may only occur if no suitable permanent resident or citizen of Australia has been identified for this position following suitable labour market testing.

## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented ICT Systems Test Engineer to join our team and play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our technology systems. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies, identifying defects, and working collaboratively with development and infrastructure teams to deliver robust, high-quality solutions. This role suits a methodical and analytical professional with a strong technical background in software and systems testing, a commitment to quality assurance best practices, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, agile environment.
## Key Responsibilities
- Specify, develop, and execute detailed test plans, test scripts, and test cases to validate the behaviour, functionality, and integrity of ICT systems across multiple platforms and environments.
- Identify, diagnose, and document functionality errors and faults in systems and programming code within established testing protocols, quality standards, and compliance guidelines to ensure systems perform to specification.
- Design and conduct regression, integration, performance, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure new and updated systems meet defined requirements and business needs.
- Utilise automated test software and frameworks to streamline testing processes, improve test coverage, and increase efficiency across the software development lifecycle.
- Produce clear and comprehensive defect reports, test summary reports, and related quality assurance documentation, ensuring traceability from requirements through to test outcomes.
- Perform systems architecture reviews and assessments, evaluating current and future hardware and software configurations, and contributing recommendations to inform strategic technical direction.
- Collaborate closely with software developers, business analysts, and project managers to clarify requirements, resolve defects, and support timely delivery of system releases.
- Create, review, and maintain technical documentation including procedural guides, operational manuals, instructional materials, technical specifications, and maintenance inventory records.
- Analyse test results and defect trends to identify recurring issues, recommend process improvements, and support continuous quality improvement initiatives across the organisation.
- Participate in agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, contributing a quality assurance perspective throughout the development cycle.
- Assess risks associated with system changes and releases, providing input into risk mitigation strategies and supporting informed decision-making across project and operational teams.
- Support the evaluation, selection, and implementation of testing tools, methodologies, and frameworks to ensure the organisation's testing capabilities remain current and effective.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A bachelor's degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
- Demonstrated experience in ICT systems testing, quality assurance, or a closely related technical role, with a solid understanding of the software development and systems engineering lifecycle.
- Proficiency in writing and executing test plans, test cases, and test scripts across functional, non-functional, and regression testing scenarios.
- Hands-on experience with test automation tools and frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, JUnit, TestNG, or comparable technologies.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose complex system faults and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Experience producing high-quality technical documentation, including test reports, defect logs, operational guides, and system specifications.
- Familiarity with agile and DevOps methodologies and the ability to integrate quality assurance activities into iterative development workflows.
- Solid understanding of systems architecture, network infrastructure, and software integration concepts relevant to enterprise ICT environments.
- Competency with defect tracking and test management tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, Zephyr, or similar platforms.
- Excellent communication, collaboration, and organisational skills, with a strong commitment to delivering quality outcomes within agreed timeframes.
## Preferred Qualifications
- ISTQB certification (Foundation Level or above) or an equivalent recognised qualification in software testing or quality assurance.
- Experience working in regulated industries or environments with strict compliance, security, or governance requirements, such as government, finance, or healthcare.
- Exposure to performance and load testing tools such as Apache JMeter, LoadRunner, or Gatling.
- Familiarity with cybersecurity testing principles, including vulnerability assessments and secure coding practices.
- Experience with cloud-based environments and platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud, and an understanding of how they impact testing strategies.
- Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and associated tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Bamboo.
- A postgraduate qualification or additional certifications in project management, IT governance, or related fields, such as ITIL or PRINCE2, would be highly regarded.
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative, inclusive, and forward-thinking team that values technical excellence and continuous improvement, where your contributions directly shape the quality of systems used across the organisation.
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for industry certifications, training programmes, and attendance at relevant conferences and events.
- Enjoy a flexible working environment with options for hybrid work arrangements, supporting a healthy work-life balance without compromising on career growth.
- Work on complex, large-scale ICT projects that offer genuine variety and the opportunity to deepen your expertise across diverse technologies and industries.
- Receive a competitive remuneration package with a clear pathway for career progression within a growing organisation that invests in its people.
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

What We Offer
